title: Five Little Monkeys: Why Gravity Always Pulls You Down!

lines.text: Five little monkeys jumping on the bed, one fell off and bumped his head!
lines.caps: Five little *MONKEYS | jumping on the *BED, | one fell off and *BUMPED | his *HEAD!

lines.text: Why did the monkey tumble DOWN instead of floating UP into space?
lines.caps: Why did the monkey *TUMBLE | *DOWN instead of | floating *UP into | *SPACE?

lines.text: Mama called the doctor and the doctor said, no more monkeys jumping on the bed!
lines.caps: Mama called the *DOCTOR | and the *DOCTOR | said, no more *MONKEYS | jumping on the *BED!

lines.text: Earth has an invisible super-magnet pulling everything down called Gravity!
lines.caps: Earth has an *INVISIBLE | super-magnet pulling *EVERYTHING | down called *GRAVITY!

lines.text: No matter how high you bounce, gravity pulls your feet back to the ground!
lines.caps: No matter how *HIGH | you bounce, *GRAVITY | pulls your feet *BACK | to the *GROUND!

lines.text: Gravity keeps our oceans, our houses, and little monkeys safely on Earth!
lines.caps: Gravity keeps our *OCEANS, | our *HOUSES, | and little monkeys *SAFELY | on *EARTH!

lines.text: So jump safely on the floor, little monkeys, and respect gravity!
lines.caps: So jump *SAFELY | on the floor, little *MONKEYS, | and respect *GRAVITY!

lines.text: Now you know the science power behind Five Little Monkeys!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the science *POWER | behind Five *LITTLE | *MONKEYS!
